verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5080 page names PyTorch among supported inference backends with 'curated, GPU-optimized SDKs' (docs-21, docs-28). The CUDA Toolkit docs describe the underlying libraries, compiler, runtime and a Python programming model (docs-19, docs-31, docs-18). However, nothing ties PyTorch or other frameworks to specific official builds or a support matrix for this GPU, and the PyTorch mention is limited to inference. Missing for 10: officially documented PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX builds for this card, a published compatibility or support matrix (CUDA/driver/framework versions), training-workload support, and independent hands-on corroboration.
